facts.text: Cambridge Beaches has welcomed guests for oceanfront escapes since 1923.
facts.excerpt: Cambridge Beaches has been a treasured destination for oceanfront escapes since 1923

facts.text: The resort has four private beaches and two private coves.
facts.excerpt: Cambridge Beaches is home to four private beaches and two private coves.

facts.text: Every accommodation has a private entrance, a dedicated outdoor seating area and views.
facts.excerpt: every accommodation at Cambridge Beaches boasts a private entrance, a dedicated outdoor seating area, and stunning views.

facts.text: Private Pool Water View Cottages have a private swim-up plunge pool overlooking the Atlantic Ocean or Mangrove Bay.
facts.excerpt: Offering an exclusive experience, our Private Pool Water View Cottages feature a private swim-up plunge pool overlooking the Atlantic Ocean or Mangrove Bay.

facts.text: Water View Rooms feature bespoke furniture and artwork by Bermudian artists.
facts.excerpt: Cozy rooms with fresh design highlighted by bespoke furniture, authentic artwork by Bermudian artists, vibrant colours, and coastal water views.

facts.text: King's Point is a five-bedroom private residence on a 4.5-acre peninsula with butler and housekeeping services.
facts.excerpt: An extraordinary five-bedroom private residence set on a 4.5-acre peninsula, surrounded by secluded coves, private beaches, and sweeping water views, with butler and housekeeping services and access to Cambridge Beaches amenities.

facts.text: King's Point was once the home of Bermudian explorer Teddy Tucker.
facts.excerpt: is one of Bermuda’s most storied coastal homes—once the residence of legendary Bermudian explorer Teddy Tucker.

facts.text: An infinity-edge pool overlooks Mangrove Bay.
facts.excerpt: Rejuvenating spa treatments, relaxing experience suites, and two pools, an infinity-edge pool that overlooks shimmering Mangrove Bay, and our indoor Aquarian Baths

facts.text: The Aquarian Baths inside the Ocean Spa have an indoor pool, a jacuzzi, a sauna, a steam room, a crystal therapy room and a cold-rain shower.
facts.excerpt: Located inside the Ocean Spa, the Aquarian Baths feature an indoor pool, jacuzzi and multiple experience suites including a sauna, steam room, crystal therapy room, and cold-rain shower.

facts.text: Ocean Spa uses Caudalie products in all of its treatments.
facts.excerpt: We proudly use the finest _**Caudalie**_ products in all of our treatments

facts.text: Ocean Spa offers organic Irish seaweed rituals from VOYA.
facts.excerpt: From VOYA's organic Irish seaweed rituals

facts.text: H2O Sports, on site, rents kayaks, paddleboards, sailboats and motorboats for exploring coves, coral reefs and shipwrecks just offshore.
facts.excerpt: Get out on the water in a kayak, paddleboard, sailboat, or motorboat and explore hidden beaches and coves, coral reefs, and shipwrecks just offshore. Located on-site at Cambridge Beaches.

facts.text: Oleander Cycles, on site, rents scooters, e-bikes and electric vehicles.
facts.excerpt: Get out and explore Bermuda with a rental from Oleander Cycles. Located on-site at Cambridge Beaches

facts.text: Long Bay Beach is the longest of the four private beaches and a vantage point for sunsets.
facts.excerpt: The longest of our four private beaches, Long Bay Beach offers a perfect locale for lounging in the sand and is a spectacular vantage point to take in magical Bermudian sunsets.

facts.text: Turtle Cove Beach is an adults-only private cove.
facts.excerpt: A private cove with soft white-sand and calm waters to bathe in the refreshing waters of the Atlantic Ocean. This adults-only beach is also a popular location for private dining and intimate destination wedding ceremonies.

facts.text: Morning Beach steps down from the pool deck onto Mangrove Bay and is known for sunrise views.
facts.excerpt: Step down from the pool deck and onto the beach to cool off in the serene waters of Mangrove Bay. A favorite spot for spectacular sunrise views and afternoon relaxation.

facts.text: The resort has a tennis court, pickleball and a basketball court.
facts.excerpt: Practice your serve on our tennis court, play a game of pickleball, or practice your shot on our basketball court.

facts.text: There is a croquet lawn and a putting green.
facts.excerpt: Play an old-fashioned game of croquet or practice your putting stroke before a round at one of Bermuda's beautiful golf courses.

facts.text: Daily afternoon tea is served in the Main House.
facts.excerpt: Join us for daily tea service in the Main House including an assortment of cookies and tea.

facts.text: Sunken Harbor Club is the Bermuda chapter of the cocktail bar created by St. John Frizell, run as a dockside tavern and tropical cocktail bar.
facts.excerpt: The Bermuda Chapter of the cocktail bar created by St. John Frizell takes its form at Cambridge Beaches as a dockside tavern and tropical cocktail bar

facts.text: Breezes is an alfresco oceanside restaurant serving lunch and dinner, where Longtail birds, grey herons and sea turtles may be sighted.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy inspired menus at lunch and dinner; linger oceanside with an expertly mixed cocktail; and take pleasure in the possibility of sighting Longtail Birds, Grey Herons, and even sea turtles from your alfresco table.

facts.text: Shoreline serves daily breakfast overlooking Mangrove Bay.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy daily breakfast in Shoreline offering traditional and island favourites in a beautiful setting overlooking Mangrove Bay.

facts.text: The resort is not ADA accessible; wheelchair ramps and elevators are not available.
facts.excerpt: Please note that Cambridge Beaches is not ADA accessible.

facts.text: Ocean Spa treatments are for guests aged 16 and over.
facts.excerpt: The Ocean Spa welcomes guests 16 years and older for spa treatments.

facts.text: The Royal Naval Dockyard is a 10-minute drive away.
facts.excerpt:
Royal Naval Dockyard
**10-Minute Drive**

facts.text: Downtown Hamilton is a 30-minute ferry ride away.
facts.excerpt:
Downtown Hamilton
**30-Minute Ferry Ride**

facts.text: The Main House shows a Black Pony Gallery exhibition of Bermudian and Caribbean artists, opened for the resort's centennial.
facts.excerpt: Black Pony Gallery's first exhibition in the resort's Main House features original paintings and limited-edition prints by five Bermudian artists

facts.text: Breezes is recognised as Bermuda's favourite alfresco restaurant.
facts.excerpt: Recognized as Bermuda's favourite alfresco restaurant
